title: A Countdown from 5 to 6
surface: A timer counts down once per second using seven illuminated segments per digit. I see 5, then 6 one second later. After another second only the top horizontal segment and lower-right vertical segment glow. The timer has neither reversed nor reset. What is wrong?
solution: The upper-right segment has failed. The actual digits are 9, 8 and 7. Removing that segment turns a 9 into a 5 and an 8 into a 6. A 7 normally uses the top and both right-hand segments, so only the top and lower-right ones remain visible.

facts.text: The display’s upper-right segment is unlit.
The true sequence 9, 8, 7 appears as 5, 6 and the two-segment remnant when that segment is missing.
All six other segments work normally and these are single-digit values.

unknowns: The device’s purpose, damage cause and repair are unspecified.
hints: Could the same segment be missing from every digit?
What happens if you add the same segment to both 5 and 6?
The upper-right segment would turn them into 9 and 8; its absence also explains the broken 7.

source.author: Mike Ball / ColdFrog
